question: Why did the error rate go up on 20 March 2026?

contributing_factors.description: The deployment of auth v4.12 to ap-south may have caused the increase in error rate.
why_chain: The deployment of auth v4.12 to ap-south introduced a new version of the authentication service.
This new version of the authentication service may have introduced bugs or incompatibilities.
These bugs or incompatibilities could have affected the service checkout in region eu-west, leading to an increase in error rate.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in error rate was due to a change in the configuration of the service checkout in region eu-west.
ruled_out.reason: The error rate and request volume remained relatively stable, indicating no significant configuration changes.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in error rate was due to a change in the traffic patterns of the service checkout in region eu-west.
ruled_out.reason: The request volume and latency remained relatively stable, indicating no significant changes in traffic patterns.

evidence.summary: Error rate for service checkout in region eu-west rose from 0.52% to 1.08% (+109%), with a change point at 2026-03-20T02:40:00Z.
The change is concentrated in service checkout in region eu-west: 1 of 12 service/region segments changed; the other segments stayed flat (largest after/before ratio 1.09).
At the same time, request volume for service checkout in region eu-west stayed about the same (289 per 5 min before, 312 per 5 min after, +8%).
At the same time, p95 latency for service checkout in region eu-west stayed about the same (219 ms before, 222 ms after, +1%).
Deployed auth v4.12 to ap-south (routine release) (auth, ap-south; 146 min before the change; record R005)
Deployed catalog v8.27 to ap-south (catalog, ap-south; 34 min after the change; record R006)

reasons: ✗ The closest change event is 146 min before the change, too far to be convincing.
✗ It concerns a different service/region than the one that changed.
✗ No logs or alerts from the affected segment confirm the problem.
✓ Request volume stayed steady, ruling out a traffic spike.
✓ No competing change event fits as well.
✓ The main factor rests on this event.
missing_data: Change records from the hour before the change
Change records for the affected service/region
Error logs or traces from the affected segment after the change

actions.action: Roll back the deployment of catalog v8.27 to ap-south to investigate the root cause and prevent further issues.
Monitor the error rate and request volume for the service checkout in region eu-west closely after the deployment of auth v4.12 to ap-south.
Review and test the new version of the authentication service (auth v4.12) in a staging environment before deploying it to production.
